page.label: Story
page.title: Story
page.lead: Learn chess step by step. Each chapter ends with a puzzle gauntlet and a boss to beat; win, and the next one opens.
page.library: Just want to browse? <library>Open the lesson library</library>.

chapter.finishPrevious: Finish the chapter before to open this one.

focus.xpTitle: Level {{level}} · {{into}} of {{total}} XP to the next level

exit.title: Wait, don’t go!
exit.body: You’ll lose this run’s momentum. The path will wait, but the coach would rather you finish.
exit.streak: Your {{days}}-day streak is still on the line today.

boss.unavailable: This chapter’s boss is not available yet. The gauntlet above still counts.
boss.beaten: {{name}} has already fallen to you, so the next chapter is open. Fight again to chase the remaining stars.
boss.stakes: Win, or at least survive twenty moves, to open the next chapter. Losing costs nothing, so retry as often as you like.
boss.note: The game opens on the Play board. Your result is recorded the moment it ends, so come back here afterwards.

gauntlet.noFresh: No fresh puzzles left in this chapter’s themes. Try again later.
gauntlet.clearedBody: Three puzzles down. {{chapter}}’s boss is waiting at the end of the path.
gauntlet.clean: First try, no hints. The boss should be worried.
gauntlet.helped: Solved. The clean solve counts double in your head.
gauntlet.hint: Hint: the circled piece makes the move.
gauntlet.arrow: The arrow shows the move: {{san}}. Play it on the board.

placement.title: Skip ahead?
placement.body: You already solve tactics like a {{rating}} player. The early chapters would be a warm-up. Start closer to your level instead.

lines: Every expert was once a beginner.
Small moves lead to big wins.
Mistakes are just lessons in disguise.
Strong players are built one game at a time.
Look at every check and every capture.
